bagPolicy.summary: Preservation Hall hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Preservation Hall is in the historic French Quarter, so parking is mostly limited to the street, with several commercial lots nearby. Walking, a taxi, rideshare or public transit is the easiest way to get there.

rideshare.summary: Preservation Hall encourages fans to walk, take a taxi or rideshare, or use public transit to reach the venue, since French Quarter parking is limited. It doesn't publish a specific pickup zone, so set your ride to 726 Saint Peter Street.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks aren't allowed. You can bring in a to-go drink from Le Spectacle, the sister cafe next door, which serves cocktails and food before shows.
allowed: To-go drink from Le Spectacle next door

accessibility.summary: Preservation Hall hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Preservation Hall hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets aren't sold at the door, so buy them on the Preservation Hall website before your visit. Cash isn't accepted at the door, staff scan your tickets on arrival, and the hall is all ages. Each ticket is good for one 45-minute performance, and the box office phone is 504-522-2841.

gates.summary: The main entrance is at 726 Saint Peter Street, and doors open about 20 minutes before showtime. Plan to arrive at least 15 minutes early. If you arrive after the show starts, staff will seat you once the current song ends.
